sophia_sales: Heads-up — we need to roll out a deprecation plan for the legacy rate card tier 'commit-tier-v1'. Targeting next quarter, need Deal Desk + Pricing approval and a clear migration path for customers. TL;DR: 90-day migration window, grandfather active contracts until EOT, special migration credits for early sign-ons.

nina_pricing: Quick q — 90 days from when? PR merge or official public notice? Also who owns customer comms? :thinking_face:

omar_dealdesk: 90 days from public notice date. We should allow grandfathering until contract term end for signed commits. For any pending POCs/LOIs, we can do exceptions w/ documented approvals. Flag any >$50k ARR deals.

alec_revops: I can handle billing mapping and the internal PR. I'll open a PR against ratecards-config and link deployment. Draft mapping snippet below for the config team:

```json
{
  "old_tier": "commit-tier-v1",
  "new_tier": "commit-tier-v2",
  "migration_window_days": 90,
  "grandfather_until_eot": true
}
```

PR will be: https://redwood.internal/prs/472 (wip).

lucy_csm: Can we get a customer email template and FAQ? I'll take the primary and coordinate with customer success. Need approvals on the language for migration credits.

omar_dealdesk: For migration incentives: propose one-time 10% migration credit OR option to extend existing commit at current rates if signed within 30 days of notice. Case-by-case approvals for larger enterprise discounts. I'll be the approver for those.

nina_pricing: That sounds reasonable. I approve the 10% migration credit and the 30-day early-extension clause. Please add explicit cutoff dates and an opt-in field in contract amendments.

sophia_sales: Great. @alec_revops can you produce a short rollout checklist (docs, billing, sales handbook updates, CS email, canary plan) and share to #eng-releases + #sales? We need a canary to catch billing mapping regressions.

alec_revops: On it. Tentative target date: 2026-05-15. I'll create rollout id `rc-deprec-v1`, canary at 5% traffic, and include automated reconciliation job to verify mapping for migrated commits. I'll ping ops for the reconciliation window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #472 merged to staging for ratecard config (rc-deprec-v1) :white_check_mark:

omar_dealdesk: Added to the approvals queue — @nina_pricing please sign off on final ratecard language in the doc and I'll route to legal for amendment templates.

nina_pricing: Signed off on language and migration terms :thumbsup:

sophia_sales: Thanks team. I'll update the Sales Handbook and post the customer email draft by EOD today. If anyone has high-risk deals that need pre-approval, drop them in this thread or DM me. :eyes:
